_meta.description: Every tunable parameter in the Meta Call predictor as of 2026-06-07. For the Predictor 5.6 redesign abgleich: backtest each lever's contribution to MAE on the 7 TEF-POR Regionals (Prague → Indianapolis), then carry forward the levers that demonstrably move the metric and drop the ones that don't.
data_sources_currently_consumed: labs_tournament_decks.csv  (in-person majors: share, day1/day2 share+wr, top1, conv)
data_sources_proposed: Player-continuity scraper — map player_id → archetype history at each Limitless event so we can measure 'is this player sticking with Festival?'
Last-7-days online tournament window — already in the data, just needs to be a separated signal (current `online_tournament_top8_decks.csv` is a rolling aggregate)
Top-8 distribution per major — labs CSV already has `top8_count`, just not exposed as a separate predictor signal

mode_a_baseline.purpose: Mode A (no labs major data yet): linear combination of ladder + brought + top8 + weekly trend.
mode_a_baseline.code_path: js/app-meta-call.js — Mode A branch in _shareList.forEach predictor body

parameters.name: w_ladder
parameters.notes: Online ladder weight. Higher → trust the ladder more.

parameters.name: w_top8
parameters.notes: Top-8-boost weight (= brought × clip(d2/d1, 0.5, 2.0)). Currently dominant signal.

parameters.name: w_weekly
parameters.notes: Weekly trend signal. Falls back to ladder when no week-ago snapshot.

phase_beta_major_anchor.purpose: Decks with ≥2 majors at ≥2% share use recency-weighted major median × PHASE_B_BLEND + ladder × (1-PHASE_B_BLEND) instead of raw ladder.

parameters.name: PHASE_B_BLEND_MAJOR
parameters.notes: Fraction of major-median in the blend. Lower means trust ladder more. Korrigiert am 02.09.2026: der Katalog fuehrte 0.7 mit Bereich [0.5, 0.85] — ein Bereich, der den echten Wert nicht einmal enthielt. Der Code steht seit laengerem auf 0.20, mit Begruendung in js/app-meta-call.js:540-547: Majors sind selten (5-6 je Format), und ein Anker, der staerker als ~20 % zum Major-Mittel zieht, ueberschaetzt Decks, die zwischen den Turnieren verblasst sind.

parameters.name: phase_b_min_majors
parameters.notes: Min number of major appearances to qualify.

predictor_4_2_ladder_damper.purpose: Damp the ladder term by per-deck top-8 conv factor. Casual decks have high ladder + low conv → damped.

parameters.name: mode_a_damper_lo
parameters.notes: Tighter bounds in Mode A (no major-anchored conv).

predictor_4_6_underdog_champion.purpose: Recent <4% regional win at ≥500 players boosts the deck for 14-28 days post-event.

predictor_4_7_online_winner.purpose: Recent online-tournament win for an underrated archetype (current ladder < 5%).

predictor_5_4_day2_growth.purpose: Reward decks that absolute-pp-grew Day-1 → Day-2 across recent majors.

predictor_5_5_last_meta_floor.purpose: Set-addition rotation only: floor each deck at previous_format full-player-weighted avg × 0.7.
predictor_5_5_last_meta_floor.gating: Only fires when format_window.set_addition_only === true AND previous_format_key set.

parameters.name: _alternative_floor_source
parameters.notes: Tried MAX(early,late) — over-pumped Dragapult solo at Indy (19.8% late vs 14.1% full). Reverted.

removed_parameters.note: Am 02.09.2026 aus der Liste genommen: PREDICTOR_5_5_DECLINE_THRESHOLD und PREDICTOR_5_5_DECLINE_DAMPER haben im Motor keine Entsprechung mehr (grep ueber js/app-meta-call.js: null Treffer). Sie standen hier als "current 0.85", also als waeren sie in Betrieb.

predictor_5_5_5_family_cap.purpose: Post-renorm hard cap on family aggregate share.

parameters.name: FAMILY_CAP_PCT
parameters.notes: Recent regional Dragapult family: Utrecht 25.1, Indy 29.3, Prague 29.4, Campinas 32.9, LA 31.9. Tune to observed ceiling.

predictor_4_5_counter_meta.purpose: Boost decks that counter the dominant family (matchup WR > 0.50, family share > 15%).

predictor_4_7_counter_adoption.purpose: Decks whose recent labs brought > recent online ladder (= field is hedging in their direction).

predictor_5_5_online_presence_floor.purpose: Final safety floor for decks that have both verified online + labs presence but were crushed by dampers.

parameters.name: PREDICTOR_55_PRESENCE_FLOOR_MIN
parameters.notes: Online share must be ≥ this to qualify.

predictor_5_6_format_leader_consolidatio.purpose: As a format matures, dominant family's lead variant consolidates (Dragapult solo within-family went 35% → 62% at Indy).

predictor_5_7_anti_leader_tech.purpose: Boost hard counters when format-leader share crosses a tech-adoption threshold.

hype_damper.purpose: When current ladder share runs ≥ 25 % ahead of brought share at a major, treat the gap as online hype and damp 25 %.
hype_damper.gating: Only fires in Mode B (current-format majors available).

_next_actions: Backtest the 5 most-impactful parameters via grid search on 6 TEF-POR Regionals — keep the combinations that move aggregate MAE below 2.0 pp top-10.
Build player-continuity scraper (limitless event pages → player_id → archetype history).
Add Turin (TEF-CRI) ground truth as JSON once user provides screenshots — re-run baseline to see floor + damper impact (these will fire here since TEF-POR → TEF-CRI is set-addition).
Decide whether to keep Predictors 5.6 / 5.7 (consolidation + anti-leader) or replace with a single 'format-maturity' signal.
